name: kotobase-storage-s3
description: Test-only harness deps. miniflare provides a real R2Bucket binding so r2-client is exercised against an R2 API implementation rather than a mock written to match it.

scripts.test: kbb --backend sci --classpath "$(kbb -Spath -M:cljs-test)" test/run.cljk && kbb --backend sci --classpath "$(kbb -Spath -M:cljs-test)" test/r2.cljk && npm run test:objects && npm run test:objects-r2 && npm run test:engine && npm run test:prolly-engine && npm run test:advanced && npm run test:bench-driver && npm run test:bench-worker
scripts.test:engine: amu compile --target wasm32-browser engine-r2 && node out/engine-r2.js
scripts.test:prolly-engine: amu compile --target wasm32-browser prolly-engine-r2 && node out/prolly-engine-r2.js
scripts.test:advanced: amu compile --target wasm32-browser advanced-r2 && node out/advanced-r2.js
